page.layout: One title page: title lines at the top, centred; below them "Cum privilegio", an engraving with its caption "ARDVA QVÆ PVLCHRA"; the imprint lines at the foot. A library stamp at the right is not transcribed.

l.i: Summam materiarum, Index, Capitum, præfixa singulis Argumenta exhibebunt.

page.notes: Engraving (between "Cum privilegio." and the imprint): a sepia-toned scene with a palm tree at left, a seated female figure with a spear or staff at left centre, an altar with a flaming candle or incense cloud at centre, and a seated female figure leaning on a column at right, above the caption "ARDVA QVÆ PVLCHRA". Not transcribed beyond its caption. The first line's "Q[?] E" is probably the decorative initial of "De", so the letter is doubtful. The date reads "cIↄ IↄC LIX" in the printed form, transcribed as MDCLIX. The library stamp (BIBL: STUD: / ACAD: LAUS) is excluded.
